scenarios.name: test-white-and-black-mana-was-paid-card
scenarios.known_bug: XP[playercountremembered-youctrl-caster-relative]: same remaining gorge cause as testOnlyBlackManaWasPaidCard. The pool 'BW' now pays {W/B} with the Plains' W and generic with the Swamp's B, so the W (Fog) half runs (p0 stays at 20) and the B half is spent, but 'each player loses 1 life for each attacking creature they control' counts the caster's attackers (Creature.YouCtrl+attacking relative to the caster) so the attacking opponent still loses 0 (want p1 19, observed 20). CR 608.2c + Oracle.
